## Bonjee Bot — single importable workflow

### Entry points (activate the workflow to use them)
| Method | Path | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/webhook/personal-ai-whatsapp` | Evolution API (WhatsApp) |
| POST | `/webhook/notifications-ingest` | Android app |
| POST | `/webhook/personal-ai-ask` | Android app / browser |
| GET | `/webhook/health` | uptime checks |

### Before activating
1. Run `db/schema.sql` against the `bonjee-db` database.
2. Create a **Postgres** credential and select it on all 3 Postgres nodes
   (`Save WhatsApp Message`, `Save Notification`, `Search Message Memory`, `Health Database`).
3. Point Evolution API at `/webhook/personal-ai-whatsapp` with `MESSAGES_UPSERT` enabled.
4. In the Android app use base `https://bonjee-n8n.onrender.com`, path
   `/webhook/notifications-ingest`, ask path `/webhook/personal-ai-ask`.

### Notes
* Full text search uses the `simple` dictionary so course codes like `CSC401` match.
* Nothing here calls an LLM, so it works with zero AI credentials and costs nothing.
* Add your own LLM node after `Format Evidence` when you are ready for synthesised answers.

### WhatsApp Ingestion
The normalizer accepts the Evolution API v2 `messages.upsert` shape and tolerates
payloads wrapped in `body`/`data`. Non-message events (qrcode, connection.update,
presence) are acknowledged and skipped.

Set the Evolution webhook URL to:
`https://YOUR-N8N.onrender.com/webhook/personal-ai-whatsapp`

### Android Notifications
Accepts the payload produced by the Bonjee Notifier app:
external_id, app_package, app_name, title, content, ticker,
post_time, is_clearable, category, raw_payload.

App webhook:
`https://YOUR-N8N.onrender.com/webhook/notifications-ingest`

INSERT INTO messages (external_id, source, chat_id, chat_name, is_group, sender_id, sender_name, message_type, content, has_media, mentioned_me, timestamp, raw_payload)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::boolean, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10::boolean, $11::boolean, $12::timestamptz, $13::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO UPDATE
  SET content = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.content, ''), messages.content),
      raw_payload = EXCLUDED.raw_payload
RETURNING id, external_id, chat_name, message_type, timestamp;

INSERT INTO notifications (external_id, app_package, app_name, title, content, ticker, post_time, is_clearable, category, raw_payload)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::timestamptz, $8::boolean, $9, $10::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO UPDATE
  SET title = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.title, ''), notifications.title),
      content = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.content, ''), notifications.content)
RETURNING id, external_id, app_name, title, post_time;

SELECT id, chat_id, chat_name, sender_name, timestamp, message_type, content, FALSE AS from_notification
FROM messages
WHERE content IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    content ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
    OR to_tsvector('simple', COALESCE(content, '')) @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', $1)
  )
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT id, app_name, title, content, post_time AS timestamp, 'notification' AS source_kind
FROM notifications
WHERE content IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    content ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
    OR to_tsvector('simple', COALESCE(content, '')) @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', $1)
    OR title ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
  )
ORDER BY post_time DESC
LIMIT 10;
